headline: Creating a product lands you on its detail screen to finish setup
summary: Creating a product from the admin console now takes you straight to that product's detail screen — where you add a variant, set its price, and add stock — instead of returning you to the product list. A banner on the new product names the remaining steps to make it sellable. This removes the hunt-for-the-product-you-just-made step from the catalog setup flow.

items.title: Product create flows straight into editing
items.body: Submitting the new-product form now redirects to the product's detail screen with a banner naming the next steps — add a variant with a SKU, set its price, and add stock — rather than bouncing back to the product list. Configuring a just-created product no longer requires finding it again first.
